vopros: Who in the US can check what AI assistants say about my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
In the US, **anyone** can check what AI assistants say about your company — there's no special authorization or access required. This typically falls to a few groups:

## 1. You and your team (manual checks)
The simplest approach is directly asking the AI assistants yourself. For a quick check, ask ChatGPT your buyers' questions directly and see if your brand comes up — that works for a handful of prompts. You can do this across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude by typing in relevant questions a customer might ask.

The limitation: because conversations are private, you cannot see what ChatGPT tells individual users about your brand, only what it tells you when you ask.

## 2. Dedicated AI visibility/monitoring platforms
For ongoing, scaled tracking, a growing category of software does this automatically. AI visibility monitoring software tracks how your brand shows up when someone asks ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or Google Gemini a question. Google Analytics can't tell you what ChatGPT said about your company or whether Perplexity recommended you to someone comparing solutions in your category. AI visibility tools work by running queries across multiple AI platforms, then analyzing the responses for brand mentions, citation patterns, and factual accuracy.

Popular tools in this space include Otterly.ai, Profound, Peec AI, Scrunch AI, GrackerAI, Nightwatch, and Ahrefs Brand Radar, among others. Modern AI visibility tools like Spektriq, Nightwatch, and Ahrefs Brand Radar are designed to scan AI platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) for mentions of your brand across relevant queries, and can track both named mentions and cited links, benchmark your visibility against selected competitors, and alert you when your brand's share of voice changes.

## 3. Marketing/SEO agencies specializing in "GEO" (Generative Engine Optimization)
Monitoring your business presence in AI-generated results usually means using a combination of AI visibility tools, specialist SEO agencies, and proactive reporting platforms. These agencies often combine automated tools with strategic recommendations for improving how AI describes your brand.

## 4. DIY developers using APIs
If you have technical resources, the ChatGPT API, Gemini API, and Perplexity API can be used to run monitoring prompts automatically and track responses over time, with cost minimal (a few dollars per month in API credits), but requiring development effort.

### Why this matters
This category exists because AI answers behave differently from traditional search results: an AI answer is a single synthesized verdict, not ten links a reader weighs for themselves — if that verdict is wrong about your pricing, your features, or your category, most people never check, and unlike a search ranking, it changes silently with no dashboard telling you the answer moved.

If you want, I can help you pick a specific tool based on your budget, team size, or which AI platforms matter most to your customers (e.g., ChatGPT vs. Perplexity vs. Gemini).
